palette: dark warm slate chalkboard + cream chalk + pastel red-chalk sanguine + sage + sky + butter highlights
typography: chalk lecture headlines, pastel label blocks, double-rule hand stamps, thin chalk underlines
composition: a dark lecture board pinning three principle pillars, a supervision column beside a leniency gate, and a statute bar column beside border-rule notes
surface: translucent chalk panels with thin dashed borders on a dusty slate board; no porcelain or walnut cards
motion: pillars, gate rows and rule notes enter in reasoning order, dashes trace condition-to-action pairs, stamps land with a slight rotation; no idle loops
transition: the lecture board persists while each scene re-pins it for a new question cluster
